high_level_description: The image depicts a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a clothing store. The individual is wearing a black polo shirt and dark pants. They have short, curly hair and are holding a smartphone with both hands, focusing on the screen. The setting is an indoor clothing store with various racks of clothes visible in the background. The racks contain neatly folded shirts and jeans, organized by color. The shirts are hung on hangers, and some are displayed on tables at the bottom of the racks. The jeans are stacked in neat piles.
